description: This PHP source file defines the 'FieldValidator' class within the SuiteCRM system, specifically for validating filter fields in the JSON API v1. It implements the ValidatorInterface, utilizes a container for dependency injection, and calls on the FieldOperator to perform validation logic on given field keys.

classes.name: FieldValidator
classes.description: Class responsible for validating filter field keys within the JSON API v1 filter system. It uses a container for dependency management and delegates validation to the FieldOperator.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the FieldValidator with a dependency injection container.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if the provided field key is valid by delegating to the FieldOperator. Throws an InvalidArgumentException if the input is not a string.
